diagnoses: SKILL.md Plan Saving section documents save-plan(plan_object, output_path) using unified_planning.io.PDDLWriter, which does not emit the required action(arg1, arg2, ...) per-line format demanded by the task prompt and writes to a planner-chosen path rather than the literal plan_output path from problem.json.

SKILL.md Example Workflow calls save_plan(plan, "task01.plan") with a hardcoded path, ignoring the per-task plan_output field in problem.json and omitting parent-directory creation plus round-trip verification.

save_plan.skill inputs are defined as (plan_object, output_path) relying on a plan object serializer; the contract must instead accept the literal plan_output path and pre-formatted plan_lines so the output matches the required textual format and exact destination.
repair_plan: In pddl-skills/SKILL.md Plan Saving section: redefine save-plan to take (plan_output_path, plan_lines, overwrite=True); require using the literal plan_output path from problem.json without renaming or extension changes; require mkdir -p of parent dirs; require UTF-8, \n newlines, one action per line formatted as name(arg1, arg2, ...), no code fences/blank lines; require post-write round-trip read verification; remove reliance on PDDLWriter for final output.

In pddl-skills/SKILL.md Example Workflow: iterate tasks from problem.json, format plan into plan_lines matching action(arg1, arg2, ...), call save-plan with task.plan_output as plan_output_path, then re-read and verify line count/format before next task.

Update save_plan.skill inputs definition inside SKILL.md to the corrected contract: plan_output_path (str, required, literal), plan_lines (list[str], required, non-empty, stripped), overwrite (bool, default True); return resolved absolute path and line count.
preservation_constraints: Keep load-problem, generate-plan, and validate sections intact.
Keep General Guidelines, Planner Behavior notes, and overall SKILL.md frontmatter unchanged.
